name: How long does a typical kitchen finish update project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen finish update project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a kitchen finish update varies based on the scope of work. Minor updates, such as repainting cabinets or replacing a backsplash, might take a few days to a week. More extensive projects involving countertop replacement, new flooring, and multiple fixture upgrades could extend to two to four weeks. Factors like material availability, custom fabrication times, and coordination of different trades can also influence the overall duration. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor updates take days to a week; more extensive projects, including countertops and flooring, can take two to four weeks. Timelines depend on the project scope and material availability.
